thread.title: Miami track and field prepares for ACC Outdoor Championships in Louisville
thread.title_full: Miami track and field prepares for ACC Outdoor Championships in Louisville

author: Sunshine Sentinel
title: Miami track and field prepares for ACC Outdoor Championships in Louisville
text:
The University of Miami track and field team is set to compete at the Atlantic Coast Conference (ACC) Outdoor Championships from Thursday through Saturday at Owsley B. Frazier Cardinal Park on the campus of the University of Louisville, according to a May 13 announcement.
The competition marks an important opportunity for Miami athletes to build on their recent performances and contend for conference titles. The event begins Thursday at 11 a.m. with the decathlon, followed by field events at noon and running events starting at 5 p.m.
Miami finished its regular season at the East Coast Relays, where several athletes achieved top-five program marks. Sean Watkins recorded the second-fastest time in school history with a run of 20.70 seconds, while George Franks improved his third-fastest time to 20.74 seconds. Jocelyn Pringle posted her second-best mark in women’s hammer throw with a distance of 63.75 meters, earning second place. Evan Pena placed third in the men’s 5000 meters with a time of 14:34.23, which is now fourth-fastest all-time for Miami.
Heading into championship weekend, four Hurricanes lead the ACC in their respective events: Franks (400 meters), Sanaa Hebron (400-meter hurdles), Magdaline Campo (high jump), and Tyson Schiele (javelin). Additionally, nine individuals rank among the top five in their events along with both men’s and women’s 4×100 relay teams and the women’s 4×400 relay team.
Live results will be available online throughout the meet, and all three days can be viewed on ACC Network Extra.
